name: Umair Jaffar
title: Full-Stack Developer
summary: I build real-time video and AI-monitoring platforms with React and TypeScript, and extend them across the stack with Node.js and Django REST Framework.
about: I'm a developer with 4 years of experience building real-time video and data-heavy products. I joined Betacodes as a Frontend Developer and was promoted to Senior within a year.

Today I lead the frontend for two production platforms: an AI broadcast monitoring system tracking 50+ live TV channels for 80+ analysts, and a GovTech dashboard that overlays AI detections on live camera feeds across 48+ factory sites.
I'm expanding into full-stack work with Node.js, Express, and Django REST Framework, and going deeper into AI for video and surveillance.
